paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model when applying layer-wise quantized pruning with SnapKV as the pruning method, under a KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents five grouped layers: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, with a categorical scale and no numerical units. The y-axis shows the "Relative Change" in percentage, ranging from -25% to 5%, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5%. Five lines are plotted: a yellow line with circular markers for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", a light blue line with circular markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit", and a gray dashed line for the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line starts at approximately 0% in Layer1-4, dips slightly to around -1% in Layer5-12, then rises to about 0% in Layer13-20, and gradually increases to roughly 2% in Layer29-32. The red line begins near 0%, decreases to about -2% in Layer5-12, dips further to approximately -5% in Layer13-20, and then recovers to around 0% in Layer29-32. The light blue line starts at about -2%, drops to around -5% in Layer5-12, plummets to approximately -15% in Layer13-20, and then rises to about -5% in Layer29-32. The dark blue line begins at approximately -5%, decreases to about -10% in Layer5-12, falls sharply to around -25% in Layer13-20, and then increases to roughly -10% in Layer29-32. The gray dashed baseline remains fixed at 0% across all layer groups.
